entries.source: StAN, Hochstift Eichstätt, Neues Stift, Urkunden nach 1500 1503/Jan/25
entries.german: Ritter Jheronimus von Rosennberg, fürstbischöflicher Hofmeister, beurkundet, dass der Streit zwischen den Pfarrern in Eichstätt und Peter Sletlein um einen Zehnten durch einen Schiedsspruch der fürstbischöflichen Räte beigelegt wurde. Zu den Schiedsleuten gehörte Jheronimus von Rosennberg.
entries.english: Jheronimus von Rosenberg, Ritter, prince-bishop’s Hofmeister, recorded that a dispute between the parish priests in Eichstätt and Peter Sletlein over a tithe was settled by arbitration by the prince-bishop’s councillors; Jheronimus von Rosenberg was among the arbitrators.

facts.content: served among the arbitrators who settled the tithe dispute between the parish priests in Eichstätt and Peter Sletlein.
certified the settlement of the tithe dispute between the parish priests in Eichstätt and Peter Sletlein.
